open_defect.summary: A JavaScript extension cannot reach vscode.commands, so no extension can register a command.
open_defect.diagnosis: In the extension's own context the probe reports typeof vscode = object but typeof vscode.commands = undefined. bindVSCodeAPI creates its own vscode object; each namespace binder looks the object up on the global, attaches its namespace and writes it back; bindVSCodeAPI then overwrites the global with its own empty local object, discarding the populated one.
open_defect.attempted_fix: Put the shared object on the global before the binders run and drop the redundant trailing assignment. This exposed the namespace but then hit a QuickJS refcount assertion (gc_decref_child, quickjs.c:6826), so it is NOT applied.
open_defect.status: OPEN - reported, not claimed as fixed
open_defect.next_step: Resolve the QuickJS reference discipline around the shared vscode object, then re-run RAWRXD_EXTENSION_HOST_001 from tracked source.

bridge.design: a narrow view of the host application, so the runtime is shared by the command line and the Win32 GUI and does not depend on the IDE's own header
bridge.verified_by: the certification asserts one class definition and the bridge include
